app.name: MindTest
app.tagline: Get to know yourself through IQ, personality, EQ and DISC tests.

login.title: Sign in to MindTest
login.subtitle: Sign in to start taking tests and save your results.
login.googleNotConfigured: Google login isn't configured yet. Set AUTH_GOOGLE_ID and AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET in your .env file.
login.devHint: Only available during development. Enter any name to try the app.
features: 4 kinds of tests in one app

dashboard.subtitle: Choose a test to take.
dashboard.noResults: No results yet. Start your first test!

test.confirmUnanswered: {count} questions are still unanswered. Blank answers count as wrong. Submit now?
test.mustAnswerAll: Please answer every question first ({count} left).
test.likertHint: How well does this statement describe you?
test.discInstruction: Pick one word that MOST describes you and one word that LEAST describes you.
test.quitConfirm: Quit the test? Answers you haven't submitted will be lost.

intro.honest: Answer honestly based on how you usually are, not how you think you should be. There are no right or wrong answers.
intro.iq: You have {minutes} minutes for {count} questions. The timer starts when you press start, and your answers are submitted automatically when time runs out.
intro.navigate: You can go back to earlier questions any time before submitting.

test.error: Something went wrong while saving your result. Please try again.

result.disclaimer: These results are for education and entertainment only, not an official psychological diagnosis. For a professional assessment, consult a licensed psychologist.

iq.note: The score is estimated from assumed norms (mean 100, SD 15). This short test does not replace a standardized IQ test.
